purpose: Science Owner's formal Stage-4 handoff: for every relevant evidence family, the governing artifact, its verified numeric result, classification, and consumption boundaries. Built entirely by reading through ml/stage3_science_resolver.py (never by guessing a filename) against the accepted Stage-3 reference below.
consumption_rule: Integration Owner must resolve current evidence via ml/stage3_science_resolver.py (resolve_current()/resolve_and_verify()) rather than reading result files directly by path. This manifest documents the resolved state as of the accepted SHA above for reference/traceability; it does not replace the resolver.

families.note_on_n: Single-subject same-dataset held-out design (Sleep-EDF), 5 optimization seeds - not a multi-subject biological-n design.
families.heterogeneity: One seed (seed46) disfavors B (-0.0096); 4/5 favor B.
families.sensitivity: Not separately computed beyond seed variance (single held-out test set).
families.strongest_safe_claim: Aligned EOG provides bounded same-dataset incremental sleep-staging value beyond EEG-only under the tested protocol.
families.prohibited_overclaim: Calling this an externally-replicated result (HMC full-cohort replication is pending, not complete).
families.architecture_relevance: Supports frontal EEG+EOG co-location as a candidate module, pending external replication.
families.unresolved_limitation: Small single held-out test set; same-dataset only; HMC full-cohort external replication pending.

families.heterogeneity: C is close to A, consistent with a genuine (not capacity-artifact) EOG-alignment effect.
families.sensitivity: Not separately computed beyond seed variance.
families.strongest_safe_claim: Aligned EOG provides bounded same-dataset incremental sleep-staging value beyond a shuffled/control-EOG condition under the tested protocol.
families.architecture_relevance: Reinforces sleep_edf_primary_ab's finding with a negative control - strengthens (does not by itself establish external validity of) the EOG case.
families.unresolved_limitation: Same-dataset only; HMC full-cohort external replication pending.

families.heterogeneity: Interaction term has both positive and negative optimization seeds - mixed, not a stable synergy or antagonism signal.
families.sensitivity: Interaction magnitude is small relative to seed noise.
families.strongest_safe_claim: No stable evidence of synergy or antagonism between EOG and respiration-derived features for sleep staging under the tested protocol.
families.prohibited_overclaim: Claiming strong multi-modal synergy between EOG and respiration.
families.architecture_relevance: Does not support combining EOG+Resp as a justified joint architecture decision beyond what each contributes individually.
families.unresolved_limitation: Same-dataset only; interaction estimate itself noisy at n=5 seeds.

families.held_out_test_biological_n: variable per fold (LOSO-style, see source for exact per-seed test composition)
families.heterogeneity: 5/5 seeds favor the aligned condition in both governing comparisons - low seed-level heterogeneity for this dataset.
families.sensitivity: Not separately computed beyond seed variance in this artifact.
families.strongest_safe_claim: IMU provides modest incremental HR-estimation value beyond a capacity-near-matched PPG-only architecture under the tested protocol.
families.prohibited_overclaim: Citing the historical unequal-capacity ~20.6%/23% figure as clean IMU marginal value (HISTORICAL_CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED); universal IMU necessity claims.
families.architecture_relevance: Supports wrist IMU co-located with PPG as a scientifically-grounded candidate.
families.unresolved_limitation: Single dataset; biological test-n limited relative to full cohort.

governing_numeric_result.interpretation: B (second site) is WORSE on aggregate

families.heterogeneity: Paired per-seed deltas range widely (0.07 to 2.11) - fragile, and a single test-subject exclusion can flip the aggregate direction (established in prior sprints).
families.sensitivity: HIGH - subject-exclusion-sensitive; n=4 test subjects is small.
families.strongest_safe_claim: A second PPG measurement site did not demonstrate stable aggregate incremental value for HR/PTT estimation under the tested protocol, and the result is fragile to subject exclusion.
families.prohibited_overclaim: Treating second-site PPG as architecture-supported or externally validated.
families.architecture_relevance: DEPRIORITIZED as a scientifically-supported addition absent another independent architectural requirement.
families.unresolved_limitation: n=4 held-out test subjects; result sign-sensitive to exclusion.

families.heterogeneity: Aggregate mean disfavors B, but 7/10 individual subjects favor B over A - a real aggregate/per-subject-direction tension, single-outlier-dominated per prior sprint's disclosure.
families.sensitivity: HIGH - single-outlier-dominated ambiguity disclosed in the governing artifact.
families.strongest_safe_claim: Additional leg BioZ did not demonstrate stable aggregate incremental value in the terrestrial body-mass-change proxy experiment and remained heterogeneous/sensitivity-fragile.
families.prohibited_overclaim: BioZ universally useless; microgravity fluid-shift invalidation.
families.architecture_relevance: Leg BioZ is an EXPERIMENTAL/DEPRIORITIZED input pending a less outlier-sensitive design.

families.note_on_n: 24 enrolled, 18 real reference-ECG-quality-eligible (6 excluded for a real corrupted-reference-ECG data-integrity defect). All 18 eligible tested exactly once across 6 grouped folds.
families.heterogeneity: 6/18 subjects favor A_cap over B; 5/18 favor C over B - real, disclosed heterogeneity, not uniform.
families.sensitivity: No sign reversal under leave-one-out exclusion of the most extreme subject; window-weighted and participant-level aggregation agree to <0.02 bpm.
families.strongest_safe_claim: Aligned IMU provides a modest aggregate benefit over the capacity-near-matched PPG baseline and deranged-IMU control in the corrected GalaxyPPG cohort, with meaningful participant heterogeneity.
families.prohibited_overclaim: Universal IMU necessity; benefit for every participant; astronaut/microgravity validation; citing the pre-fix 24-subject INVALIDATED results as current.
families.architecture_relevance: This is the strongest independent-device-family replication evidence for wrist PPG+IMU co-location.
families.unresolved_limitation: Real, disclosed subject heterogeneity (not a uniform effect); independent-device replication is on one additional dataset only.

families.experiment_protocol_version: protocol-compliant v2 (0-60mmHg enforced, different-stage C-control enforced)
families.note_on_n: 16 enrolled, 12 real actual-file-verified eligible (4 excluded for missing pleth data). 407/607 windows in-scope (0-60mmHg); 200 excluded.
families.heterogeneity: A_minus_B sign-reverses excluding subject 9 (extreme outlier); C_minus_B remains negative but shrinks substantially excluding subject 9.
families.sensitivity: HIGH - both key comparisons substantially influenced by one subject.
families.strongest_safe_claim: Under the frozen terrestrial 0-60 mmHg LBNP protocol, thoracic EIS did not show stable aggregate incremental value beyond ECG+pleth, with substantial subject heterogeneity.
families.prohibited_overclaim: Universal BioZ uselessness; a stable/uniform negative; microgravity/astronaut fluid-shift disproven; citing the old 607-window HISTORICAL_SUPERSEDED_OUT_OF_PROTOCOL result as current.
families.architecture_relevance: Does not support thoracic EIS for the tested LBNP-stage target; other targets/sites untested.
families.unresolved_limitation: n=12; both A-B and C-B substantially subject-9-influenced; only thoracic site and LBNP-stage target tested.

families.heterogeneity: Test metric driven entirely by ONE test recording - seed variance reflects within-recording noise, not between-subject variance.
families.sensitivity: n=7 (1 test recording) far too small to conclude anything about the full 151-recording cohort.
families.strongest_safe_claim: At this bounded diagnostic scale, the Sleep-EDF EOG benefit did not reproduce on HMC.
families.prohibited_overclaim: Treating this as external replication or non-replication of the Sleep-EDF EOG finding; promoting to full-cohort status.
families.architecture_relevance: Cannot currently confirm or deny EOG's independent value in an external clinical cohort - full-cohort HMC training would materially change confidence here.
families.consumption_status: GOVERNING (status: BOUNDED_DIAGNOSTIC - the only trained HMC evidence)
families.unresolved_limitation: n=7, 1 test recording; full-151-cohort training LOWER_PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_WORK_PENDING.

A_B_C_definitions.C: full montage with deranged extra channels

families.prohibited_overclaim: Using this n=3 diagnostic to select final EEG channel architecture.
families.architecture_relevance: Full ~65-subject cohort (LOWER_PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_WORK_PENDING) would materially change confidence in sparse-vs-full EEG architecture.
families.unresolved_limitation: n=3; full ~65-subject cohort pending (~93GB/~9.4h additional download quantified, not attempted).
